neighbours.label: verb naming a methodological action in a description of how something is done or studied (involves monitoring, by measuring, ensure that)
fire: The temperature method involves monitoring body heat every morning before rising.
Researchers tested the drug by measuring blood pressure in two hundred volunteers.
The protocol was designed to ensure that every sample was handled the same way.
The technique works by tracking eye movements while participants read.
Engineers evaluated the bridge by recording vibrations during heavy traffic.
The trial assessed recovery by counting how many steps patients could walk.
Firms must report details of their fees before clients sign a contract.
The survey estimates income by asking households about their monthly spending.
quiet: The temperature method was popular in the early twentieth century in Europe.
Researchers tested the drug in two hundred volunteers over the summer.
The protocol was long and the samples were stored in a cold room.
The technique was invented in a small laboratory in Sweden.
Engineers evaluated the bridge last year after the heavy storm.
The trial took place in three hospitals with many elderly patients.
Firms have offices in London and clients in many countries.
The survey covered households in rural areas across the region.

notes: Card: 'involves monitoring body temperature', 'by measuring patients' responses', 'ensure that', 'must give details', 'even when mice are fed'.
